text:
Maya: Quick sync — thinking of a 'beta hook' that grants design partners 100k free tokens + a dedicated sandbox instance for 2 weeks. Thoughts? @Sam @Lucas
Sam: Love the hook. Two quick asks: what's our provisional SLA during beta (p95 latency) and are we guaranteeing reserved capacity? :thinking:
Lucas: For design partners I'd avoid a hard SLA right away. Proposal: tiered option — default no-SLA, Pilot SLA (reserved pool, 99.9% uptime, <250ms p95 for short seq). That way we can limit scope for early partners.
Maya: Agree. Ops choreography question: handoff checklist from AE -> SE -> Eng on day 0. My rough checklist: 1) model & version pinned 2) routing policy & fallback 3) quota limits & burst settings 4) contact + oncall schedule 5) eval prompt set.
Emily: Can you paste that as a quick snippet? I'll turn it into an onboard task list.
Maya: Sure — ```
1) Model/version pinned (hash)
2) Routing policy (region, cost tier)
3) Quota & burst config (tokens/min)
4) Oncall + escalation matrix (pager/link)
5) Eval prompt set + acceptance criteria
```
Sam: Feedback loop: weekly async digest (notion doc) + a short 1:1 each week for the first month. We should also require partners to run a 200-prompt eval harness we define so we can track regressions.
Lucas: For private/Dedicated partners we must surface KMS/VPC constraints. Cannot do automatic model pulls for on-prem — add an install window and SOW item for model sync.
Maya: Good catch. Launch criteria I'm proposing: 
- 3 design partners onboarded and actively using (>=10k tokens/day for 3 consecutive days)
- Regression rate on eval set <5% vs baseline
- No Sev1 incidents for 7 days post-onboard
- Ops runbook completed and verified (including rollback steps)
Sam: +1. Also add a SLA-lite acceptance: confirmation of capacity reservation for each partner for their pilot window.
ops-bot: NOTE: Planned capacity carveouts must be requested at least 72 hours before start time — ops ticket template: `#pilot-capacity {customer, start, end, config}`
Emily: I'll draft the invite email and the onboarding checklist today. Will include the eval harness link and a short FAQ about billing (free tokens -> usage after window).
Maya: Great. Can someone own the partner onboarding sign-off? I nominate @Sam for sign-off on performance, and @Emily for onboarding completeness.
Sam: I can do performance sign-off for first cohort.
Emily: I'll own onboarding completeness and the invite template. Draft will land in #product-docs by EOD Thu.
Maya: Awesome — I'll add this to the roadmap sprint and mark as 'pilot intake ready'. Tagging for product planning board. :white_check_mark:
